Vaibhav Suryavanshi being appointed East Zone vice-captain doesn’t make much sense. He’s still a kid, still learning his game, and has only just started his domestic journey. Why add leadership responsibilities at this stage when there are more experienced players in the squad?

This is an emotional decision than a cricketing one. Right now, Vaibhav doesn’t need a leadership tag. He needs matches, experience and time to develop his game. The captaincy can come later if he continues to grow.
